# Rotex Nova fixtures

The five `nova_*.slang` files are unchanged copies of `shaders/nova_*.slang`
from [Rotex Examples at 654bef61](https://github.com/rotex-labs/rotex-examples/tree/654bef61ea3a22d516e2ad6a6a249346d14afdd4/shaders).
They are distributed here under the accompanying [MIT license](LICENSE-MIT).

Their Git blobs also match the Nova fixtures in the architecture baseline
`rotex-dev@d6d75510b1395f9e358a5d4f1f7492d8d919798e:examples/rotex-examples/shaders/`.
